title: 美股科技回吐与A/H宽度走弱压制风险偏好，流动性投放及机器人、医药事件提供结构线索
summary: 11月24日纳指跌1.48%、美股半导体行业跌6.67%，A股3498家下跌且恒生科技跌1.24%；央行预告8000亿元MLF与5000亿元逆回购。微创机器人、长风药业、信科移动与天齐锂业列为条件关注，神雾节能列为回避，均等待公告后有效交易时段确认。

关键词云图

美股硬件回吐生物科技防御流动性加量科创相对强港股科技承压北斗短报文手术机器人订单吸入药IND锂资源整合控股股东增持A股宽度偏弱财务造假风险
正面负面中性w1-w5表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美股出现道指走强、科技走弱的显著背离
11月24日道指涨0.85%至50,018.70点，标普500跌0.50%，纳指跌1.48%；科技股回吐前一日反弹，防御与传统经济板块相对占优。 来源
榜单
百货与生物科技领涨，硬件与半导体位居末端
08:34 CST快照显示百货公司、生物技术涨6.16%和6.01%；计算机硬件、半导体、电子元件、半导体设备跌8.17%、6.67%、5.93%和5.81%。概念前五中四项为医药方向。 来源
政策
央行预告1.3万亿元中长期与短期流动性操作
人民银行公告11月25日开展8000亿元一年期MLF与5000亿元7天期逆回购；实际中标利率与资金传导仍需观察。 MLF 逆回购
政策
工信部就北斗短报文通信服务管理办法征求意见
征求意见稿11月24日发布、反馈截至12月25日；卫星通信与终端链受益仍取决于正式规则和商业订单。 来源
市场
A股指数温和但宽度偏弱，港股科技继续承压
11月24日上证涨0.27%、科创50涨1.81%，创业板跌0.05%；A股1951家上涨、3498家下跌。恒指、国企指数和恒生科技跌0.80%、1.08%和1.24%。 来源
公司
天齐锂业拟收购关联锂矿资产
公司拟现金收购天齐兴宇100%和润丰矿业76.5269%股权；关联定价、资金占用与资源兑现是反证。A股11月24日收32.20元、跌0.80%，早于晚间公告。 来源
港股
微创机器人图迈全球商业化订单突破400台
中国年内新增37台、海外超过200台并覆盖70多个国家和地区；订单不等于当期收入，交付与回款待验证，公告后有效交易时段尚未开始。 来源
港股
长风药业ICF001获FDA许可推进I期研究
FDA函件允许拟议I期研究按IND推进，但并非安全性、有效性或上市批准。11月24日收4.43港元，早于晚间公告。 来源
公司
信科移动控股股东首次增持并公布后续计划
中国信科集团增持200万股、成交1899.07万元，并计划六个月内继续增持、总额不超过2亿元。11月24日约收9.44元、涨3.51%，公告后确认仍待开盘。 来源
风险
神雾节能与大烨智能因年报虚假记载面临风险警示
监管告知书指向历史年报虚假记载；两家公司11月25日停牌一天、拟11月26日复牌并实施其他风险警示。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

指数背离
指数背离
11月24日道指涨0.85%，标普跌0.50%，纳指跌1.48%；价值与防御承接，不能把道指走强外推为全面风险偏好回升。
板块分化
板块分化
百货与生物科技涨逾6%，计算机硬件、半导体与电子元件跌5.93%至8.17%；四项医药概念进入前五，防御轮动强于AI硬件。
A/H映射
A/H映射
美股硬件与半导体下挫对A/H算力、芯片设备和电子元件构成负面映射；医药与机器人事件只形成条件线索，需今日开盘量价确认。

盘前结论

事实：纳指跌1.48%、美股半导体行业跌6.67%；A股3498家下跌，恒生科技跌1.24%。

判断：A/H有流动性投放支撑，但科技链先看回吐压力；机器人、医药、北斗和增持只适合条件关注。

不确定性：当前为开盘前，五张卡均无公告后有效交易时段确认；不把旧收盘价或停牌写成实时买点。

重点个股关注

微创机器人-B
02252.HK
条件关注
事实与状态：图迈订单突破400台，中国年内37台、海外超过200台；公告后有效交易时段尚未开始，可靠公告后报价不可得。 来源
确认条件：开盘后相对恒生医疗与机器人同业强势，且交付、装机、收入确认和回款验证订单质量。
风险与失效条件：订单不等于收入；若高开回落、持续弱于同业或装机回款滞后，取消关注。
长风药业
02652.HK
条件关注
事实与状态：ICF001获FDA许可推进I期；11月24日收4.43港元，早于晚间公告，不能作为公告后确认。 来源
确认条件：开盘后相对港股创新药同业走强，且I期启动、入组与安全性数据按计划推进。
风险与失效条件：I期不等于有效性或上市批准；若弱于同业或临床延迟，取消关注。
信科移动
688387.SH
条件关注
事实与状态：控股股东增持200万股、成交1899.07万元，计划六个月内增持不超过2亿元；11月24日约收9.44元、涨3.51%，公告后价格未确认。 来源
确认条件：今日开盘后保持相对通信设备板块强势，且后续增持持续发生并披露。
风险与失效条件：上限不等于必然完成；若放量跌破公告前收盘或增持不执行，取消关注。
天齐锂业
002466.SZ / 09696.HK
条件关注
事实与状态：拟现金收购天齐兴宇100%和润丰矿业76.5269%；A股11月24日收32.20元、跌0.80%，H股收24.12港元、跌4.21%，均早于公告。 来源
确认条件：A/H开盘后相对锂矿同业止跌走强，并披露公允定价、资金来源和开发时间表。
风险与失效条件：关联交易、现金支出、矿权兑现与锂价风险并存；若继续弱于同业则转为回避。
神雾节能
000820.SZ
回避
事实与状态：监管告知书指向2024年年报虚假记载，公司11月25日停牌并拟实施其他风险警示；停牌无有效报价。 来源
重新评估条件：正式处罚、财务更正、内控整改和持续经营影响充分披露，复牌后价格与流动性稳定。
风险与失效条件：会计、治理、索赔与退市相关风险优先，在整改和复牌验证前维持回避。

板块轮动看板

结构线索

百货、生物科技及医药概念领涨，美股从AI硬件转向防御与传统消费。

本地支点

央行流动性、北斗规则，以及机器人、医药与通信事件提供结构线索。

压力方向

美股硬件、半导体与元件显著下跌，A股宽度偏弱、恒生科技下跌。

验证信号

观察A/H科技相对强弱、公告后首个交易时段、锂交易定价和增持执行。

逻辑链

纳指-1.48%且半导体行业-6.67% → AI硬件回吐 → A/H芯片、服务器与电子元件先防守而非追涨。
百货和生物技术涨逾6%、四项医药概念进前五 → 防御轮动 → 医药事件需本地同业与公告后价格确认。
8000亿元MLF + 5000亿元逆回购 → 流动性支撑 → 有助稳定大盘，但不能抵消3498家下跌的弱宽度。
公司公告分化 → 机器人订单、FDA IND与增持提供催化；关联锂交易与财务造假形成反证 → 按条件关注与回避分层。

风险雷达

美股硬件、半导体、电子元件和半导体设备跌幅均超过5%，A/H科技映射可能继续承压。
A股11月24日下跌家数3498家，指数小涨不代表多数股票风险偏好改善。
天齐锂业为关联现金收购，定价、资金和矿权兑现均需后续披露。
神雾节能与大烨智能面临年报虚假记载及风险警示，会计与治理风险优先。
机器人订单和临床许可不等于当期收入或最终商业成功，公告后量价仍未知。

数据来源与时间点

扫描截至2026-11-25 08:42 CST；发现源为上证报/东方财富与第一财经，原始核验覆盖人民银行、工信部、上交所及港交所；行情基线为AKShare 11月24日收盘快照，美股排行抓取于11月25日08:34 CST，国际市场以Reuters和收盘数据交叉核验。开盘前报价缺口逐卡披露。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates importance, not return magnitude.
Major News
Global
US equities split sharply between the Dow and technology
On Nov 24 the Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70, while the S&P 500 fell 0.50% and the Nasdaq lost 1.48%. Technology gave back gains as defensive and old-economy shares outperformed. Source
Ranking
Department stores and biotech led while hardware and chips lagged
The 08:34 CST snapshot showed department stores and biotechnology up 6.16% and 6.01%. Computer hardware, semiconductors, electronic components and semiconductor equipment fell 8.17%, 6.67%, 5.93% and 5.81%. Four of the five leading concepts were healthcare-related. Source
Policy
PBOC announced RMB1.3 trillion of medium- and short-term liquidity operations
The PBOC announced RMB800 billion of one-year MLF and RMB500 billion of seven-day reverse repos for Nov 25. Award rates and transmission still require confirmation. MLF Reverse repo
Policy
MIIT sought comments on BeiDou short-message service rules
The draft was released Nov 24 with comments due by Dec 25. Benefits to satellite communications and terminals still depend on final rules and commercial orders. Source
Market
A-share indices were mixed with weak breadth as Hong Kong tech stayed under pressure
On Nov 24 Shanghai rose 0.27% and STAR 50 gained 1.81%, while ChiNext slipped 0.05%. A-shares had 1,951 gainers and 3,498 decliners; HSI, HSCEI and Hang Seng TECH fell 0.80%, 1.08% and 1.24%. Source
Company
Tianqi Lithium proposed acquiring related-party lithium assets
The company proposed cash acquisitions of 100% of Tianqi Xingyu and 76.5269% of Runfeng Mining. Related-party valuation, funding and resource conversion are counterevidence. Its A-share closed Nov 24 at RMB32.20, down 0.80%, before the announcement. Source
HK stock
MicroPort MedBot's Toumai global commercial orders exceeded 400 units
China added 37 orders this year and overseas orders exceeded 200 across more than 70 countries and regions. Orders are not current revenue; delivery and collections need verification, and no valid post-event session has begun. Source
HK stock
CF PharmTech's ICF001 received FDA clearance to proceed with Phase I
The FDA letter allows the proposed Phase I study under the IND, but is not confirmation of safety, efficacy or approval. The stock closed Nov 24 at HKD4.43 before the announcement. Source
Company
CICT Mobile's controller initiated purchases and announced a follow-on plan
CICT Group bought 2 million shares for RMB18.9907 million and plans further purchases within six months capped at RMB200 million. The stock closed around RMB9.44, up 3.51%, but post-event confirmation awaits the open. Source
Risk
Shenwu Energy Saving and Daye Intelligent faced special-treatment warnings
Regulatory notices cited false historical annual reports. Both companies are suspended Nov 25 and expected to resume Nov 26 under special-treatment warnings. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index divergence
Index divergence
On Nov 24 the Dow rose 0.85%, the S&P fell 0.50% and the Nasdaq lost 1.48%. Value and defensive shares found support, so Dow strength does not confirm a broad risk-on move.
Sector split
Sector split
Department stores and biotech gained more than 6%, while computer hardware, semiconductors and components fell 5.93%–8.17%. Four healthcare concepts reached the top five, showing defensive rotation over AI hardware.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
The US hardware and semiconductor decline is a negative read-through for A/H compute, chip equipment and components. Healthcare and robotics events are conditional signals pending today's opening price action.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: Nasdaq fell 1.48% and US semiconductors lost 6.67%; 3,498 A-shares declined and Hang Seng TECH fell 1.24%.

View: Liquidity supports A/H, but technology faces giveback pressure; robotics, drugs, BeiDou and controller buying are conditional watches only.

Uncertainty: This is pre-open and none of the five cards has valid post-event session confirmation; prior closes and suspension are not live entry points.

Stocks to Watch

MicroPort MedBot-B
02252.HK
Conditional watch
Fact and status: Toumai orders exceeded 400 units, with 37 in China this year and more than 200 overseas. No valid post-event session has begun, so a reliable post-event quote is unavailable. Source
Confirmation: outperform Hong Kong healthcare and robotics peers after the open, with delivery, installation, revenue recognition and collections validating order quality.
Risk and invalidation: orders are not revenue; cancel if the stock fades, lags peers, or installation and collections fall behind.
CF PharmTech
02652.HK
Conditional watch
Fact and status: ICF001 received FDA clearance to proceed into Phase I. The Nov 24 close of HKD4.43 preceded the announcement and is not post-event confirmation. Source
Confirmation: outperform Hong Kong biotech peers after the open, followed by timely Phase I initiation, enrollment and safety data.
Risk and invalidation: Phase I is not efficacy or approval; cancel if price lags peers or clinical progress slips.
CICT Mobile
688387.SH
Conditional watch
Fact and status: the controller bought 2 million shares for RMB18.9907 million and plans up to RMB200 million more within six months. The stock closed around RMB9.44, up 3.51%, but post-event price action is unconfirmed. Source
Confirmation: maintain relative strength versus communications-equipment peers after today's open, with continued disclosed purchases.
Risk and invalidation: the cap is not guaranteed execution; cancel if price breaks the pre-event close on volume or purchases do not continue.
Tianqi Lithium
002466.SZ / 09696.HK
Conditional watch
Fact and status: proposed cash acquisitions of 100% of Tianqi Xingyu and 76.5269% of Runfeng Mining. The A-share closed at RMB32.20, down 0.80%, and H-share at HKD24.12, down 4.21%, both before the announcement. Source
Confirmation: A/H shares stabilize and outperform lithium peers after the open, with fair valuation, funding and a development timetable disclosed.
Risk and invalidation: related-party valuation, cash outlay, mining execution and lithium-price risk remain; move to avoid if both listings lag peers.
Shenwu Energy Saving
000820.SZ
Avoid
Fact and status: a regulatory notice cited false 2024 annual-report records. Trading is suspended Nov 25 ahead of a special-treatment warning, so no valid quote exists. Source
Reassessment: final sanctions, restatement, remediation and going-concern effects are disclosed, followed by stable post-resumption price and liquidity.
Risk and invalidation: accounting, governance, claims and delisting-related risks dominate; remain avoid until remediation and post-resumption validation.

Sector Rotation Board

Structural leads

Department stores, biotech and healthcare led as US rotation moved away from AI hardware.

Local supports

PBOC liquidity, BeiDou rules, and robotics, drug and communications events offer selective catalysts.

Pressure points

US hardware, semiconductors and components fell sharply amid weak A-share breadth and lower Hang Seng TECH.

Signals to verify

Watch A/H technology relative strength, first post-event sessions, lithium valuation and execution of purchases.

Logic Chain

Nasdaq -1.48% and semiconductors -6.67% → AI hardware gave back → treat A/H chips, servers and components defensively rather than chase.
Department stores and biotech gained over 6%, with four healthcare concepts in the top five → defensive rotation → local peer and post-event price confirmation is required.
RMB800bn MLF + RMB500bn reverse repo → liquidity support → helpful for stability but not enough to erase 3,498 decliners.
Company events diverged → robot orders, FDA IND and controller purchases offered catalysts; the related lithium deal and accounting fraud supplied counterevidence → conditional watch versus avoid.

Risk Radar

US hardware, semiconductors, components and chip equipment each fell more than 5%, pressuring A/H technology read-throughs.
A-shares had 3,498 decliners on Nov 24, so modest index gains did not represent broad risk improvement.
Tianqi's related-party cash acquisition still needs disclosure on valuation, funding and mining execution.
Shenwu and Daye face false-report and special-treatment issues, making accounting and governance risks dominant.
Robot orders and a clinical-study clearance do not equal current revenue or eventual success; post-event price action is unknown.

Sources and Cutoff

Scan cutoff: 2026-11-25 08:42 CST. Discovery sources were Shanghai Securities News/Eastmoney and Yicai, with primary checks against PBOC, MIIT, SSE and HKEX. The market baseline is the AKShare Nov 24 close snapshot; US rankings were fetched at 08:34 CST on Nov 25, with international markets cross-checked against Reuters and closing data. Pre-open quote gaps are disclosed card by card.
